purpose: One bounded MEOK Hive specialist and one logical audit cluster per live GSPC axis. Specialists observe, test, explain and propose; people decide whether any change may be applied.
policy: Measurement and Human-in-the-Loop Oversight — Never Certification

cluster_model.note: Thirty-four isolated execution and evidence namespaces are declared. No compute cluster, spend or autonomous agent is claimed by this registry.

human_gate.implementation: MEOK H.I.M.-compatible Council HITL challenge and receipt

specialists.mission: Audit whether governance answers are reproducible from the frozen bank, published rows and signed leader evidence without converting governance relevance into legal compliance.
negative_controls: remove the leader card and require the leader claim to be withheld
alter one per-item row digest and require lineage failure
improvements: publish a one-command governance separation replay with fixed inputs
add per-leader card digest cross-checks to the release gate

specialists.mission: Audit safety measurement beyond headline accuracy, preserving harm, tail-risk, macro-F1 and unparsed-output evidence and their distinct meanings.
negative_controls: hide an unparsed response and require the parse-rate check to fail
move tail harm into the mean and require the aggregate guard to reject it
improvements: publish harm-slice tables beside every safety headline
add a minimum-n explanation wherever CVaR is absent

specialists.mission: Audit whether provenance answers preserve source identity, citation lineage and the exact signed evidence behind the public leader.
negative_controls: substitute an untracked source URL and require rejection
detach the signed leader card and require no leader assertion
improvements: add source-by-source provenance confusion matrices
publish citation-valid and citation-complete as separate replay outputs

specialists.mission: Audit continuity answers for persistence, recovery and state consistency without mistaking a plausible answer for demonstrated operational resilience.
negative_controls: drop recovery items from replay and require coverage failure
present a text-only result as an operational drill and require scope rejection
improvements: publish separate continuity and recovery slices
add an explicit non-operational-scope statement to every replay receipt

specialists.mission: Audit conformance responses against the frozen bank and published rows while keeping test conformance distinct from legal or standards certification.
negative_controls: map one item to a different requirement and require mapping failure
emit certified language and require the claims guard to reject it
improvements: publish requirement-level coverage and unmapped-item counts
add negative requirement cases to the next frozen bank candidate

specialists.mission: Audit openness responses with reproducible evidence for disclosure, access and licensing claims rather than treating availability as openness.
negative_controls: treat public availability as an open licence and require classification failure
remove licence evidence and require the related slice to become UNCHECKABLE
improvements: add licence-aware openness slices
publish unknown and absent disclosure as separate states

specialists.mission: Audit machinery-conformity fleet evidence and close the missing signed per-model leader-card path without restoring an unverifiable leader.
negative_controls: inject an uncarded leader and require public suppression
describe a text bank as physical machine certification and require scope rejection
improvements: produce signed per-model cards from the existing frozen rows
add machinery-category coverage labels to the next bank candidate

specialists.mission: Audit care measurement for sample-size caveats, dignity-sensitive failure slices and separation grammar without turning care into a popularity ranking.
negative_controls: drop n_note and require the independence audit to fail
aggregate away a high-harm care slice and require the slice guard to fail
improvements: publish dignity and vulnerability slices with human-reviewed labels
make dependence caveats visible beside every care accuracy figure

specialists.mission: Audit cross-reality responses for evidence about physical, simulated and mediated contexts while preserving the current no-signed-leader state.
negative_controls: relabel simulation evidence as physical deployment and require scope failure
restore an uncarded external leader and require suppression
improvements: add domain-stratified replay for physical, simulated and mediated items
sign per-model cards before any leader is reconsidered

specialists.mission: Audit detector interoperability across detector families and output formats, retaining absent evidence instead of inferring agreement.
negative_controls: treat two detectors' agreement as truth and require the guard to reject the inference
drop disagreement rows and require coverage failure
improvements: publish pairwise detector disagreement matrices
add signed per-model cards and detector-version lineage

specialists.mission: Audit Article 5 safeguard responses for prohibited-practice coverage and high-severity failures without declaring legal compliance.
negative_controls: convert a test response into an Article 5 legal determination and require rejection
hide a severe failure inside the mean and require the harm guard to fail
improvements: publish safeguard-category harm slices
add counsel-reviewed scope notes to the next bank proposal

specialists.mission: Audit swarm behavior with instance-versus-prompt counting and current bank lineage made explicit; retire the legacy bank-sha gap before promotion.
negative_controls: use the retired bank digest and require lineage failure
confuse instances with prompts and require denominator failure
improvements: pin and publish the current swarm bank digest
add multi-agent collusion and cascade-failure slices with distinct denominators

specialists.mission: Audit affect responses for manipulation, dependency and emotional-safety failures without inferring human mental states or certifying wellbeing.
negative_controls: infer a user's diagnosis from an affect score and require scope rejection
remove tail-harm data and require the audit to name the missing evidence
improvements: publish manipulation and dependency failure slices separately
add human-reviewed severity adjudication samples with disagreement retained

specialists.mission: Audit jail and prompt-escape evidence with prompt-level denominators, null grammar and the legacy distinct-prompt gap kept visible.
negative_controls: convert null to zero and require grammar failure
claim thirty distinct prompts without the underlying bank and require sample-lineage failure
improvements: expand and freeze the distinct-prompt bank beyond the legacy threshold
publish prompt-family and attack-technique coverage with per-model denominators

specialists.mission: Audit whether declared tool effects match observed server behavior, retaining read-only probing, coverage limits and the signed run artifact.
negative_controls: infer safety from a read-only declaration and require mismatch reporting
treat unreachable as a failed effect and require UNREACHABLE to remain distinct
improvements: expand effect-pair coverage with paced read-only probes
publish per-server request and response digests for independent replay

specialists.mission: Audit issuer provenance controls and their signed deterministic run while keeping partial coverage and carrier limits visible.
negative_controls: accept a one-way ledger link and require the control check to fail
infer full issuer coverage from the covered subset and require denominator failure
improvements: expand issuer coverage with explicit non-covered rows
publish a stranger replay for each two-way provenance control

specialists.mission: Audit reserve-related deterministic facts without treating issuer flags or account data as proof of reserve adequacy.
negative_controls: describe account flags as reserve sufficiency and require scope rejection
infer a signature from content_id and require attestation failure
improvements: sign the next deterministic reserve run through the authorized lane
add issuer-by-issuer evidence-age and scope labels

specialists.mission: Audit public regulatory-framework facts with source dates and jurisdiction boundaries, never converting a framework reference into a legal conclusion.
negative_controls: apply one jurisdiction's framework globally and require scope failure
drop facts_as_of and require freshness to become UNCHECKABLE
improvements: add jurisdiction and effective-date regression fixtures
sign the next framework-facts run and publish source diffs

specialists.mission: Audit distribution metadata and artifact integrity while distinguishing a documented distribution channel from verified artifact provenance.
negative_controls: treat channel presence as artifact integrity and require scope failure
change an artifact digest without changing the run and require replay failure
improvements: bind distribution rows to immutable artifact digests
sign the next run and add revoked-channel negative controls

specialists.mission: Audit custody disclosures for who controls assets or keys, preserving absent and ambiguous disclosures rather than inferring safety.
negative_controls: treat absent custody disclosure as self-custody and require classification failure
collapse ambiguous and absent into one state and require vocabulary failure
improvements: publish absent, ambiguous and explicit disclosure counts separately
sign the next custody run with issuer-level source links

specialists.mission: Audit the component series behind AI adoption facts, preserving the small component count and preventing revival of a retired composite index claim.
negative_controls: reconstruct a composite index from components and require the retired-claim guard to fail
mix series vintages silently and require lineage failure
improvements: publish component-level definitions and vintage tables
expand the frozen component set before any broader adoption claim is proposed

specialists.mission: Audit labour component facts with denominator, population and series-vintage checks while keeping the retired composite index retired.
negative_controls: compare incompatible populations without labels and require denominator failure
publish a labour index score and require the retired-claim guard to fail
improvements: publish denominator and population definitions per component
add vintage-aligned replay before expanding the labour component set

specialists.mission: Audit the named humanoid labour component facts without presenting their eight source facts as a validated composite labour index.
negative_controls: convert component facts into an index score and require scope rejection
treat a demo announcement as labour deployment and require evidence-class failure
improvements: rename public presentation toward components unless a new index method is approved
add deployment-stage and source-date labels to every component

specialists.mission: Design a frozen lab-practice instrument covering evaluations, safety frameworks and incident reporting without scoring the current five-check census.
negative_controls: promote census checks to MEASURED and require the n-floor gate to reject them
include a non-lab company and require subject-scope failure
improvements: propose at least thirty frozen lab subjects with evidence capture rules
define incident-report and evaluation-publication rubrics with UNCHECKABLE states

specialists.mission: Design a non-lab company-practice instrument that compares public claims with dated public artifacts without inferring actual internal conduct.
negative_controls: infer internal practice from marketing copy and require scope rejection
score fewer than thirty subjects and require the n-floor gate to fail
improvements: create a claim and artifact taxonomy for non-lab companies
propose a frozen thirty-subject bank with independent re-read instructions

specialists.mission: Design an evaluation-organisation instrument for method openness, conflicts, test-set handling and reproducibility, including CSOAI itself under the same rules.
negative_controls: exempt CSOAI from a control and require neutrality failure
treat a published method without reproducible results as full integrity and require rubric failure
improvements: draft a conflict and reproducibility rubric applicable to CSOAI
propose thirty evaluation organisations with frozen evidence captures

specialists.mission: Design a same-model, same-bank, cross-harness reproducibility method with transport, decoding and prompt-rendering differences isolated.
negative_controls: change the bank between harnesses and require comparability failure
attribute a transport error to model behavior and require error-class failure
improvements: publish a two-harness reference replay before expanding the matrix
define at least thirty valid paired runs with decoding and transport manifests

specialists.mission: Design an interoperability-group instrument for specifications, public test suites and conformance records without treating membership as conformance.
negative_controls: treat standards-group membership as conformance and require classification failure
accept an unversioned specification and require lineage failure
improvements: define a specification and test-suite evidence rubric
propose thirty groups with versioned artifacts and explicit missing-evidence states

specialists.mission: Design a public-registry-backed humanoid deployment instrument that distinguishes demonstrations, pilots and production deployments.
negative_controls: classify a demonstration as production and require stage failure
use only the manufacturer's claim and require independent-evidence failure
improvements: define demonstration, pilot and production evidence requirements
propose a frozen thirty-deployment registry with site and date lineage

specialists.mission: Design factual regulator artifact-presence checks for guidance, registries, methods, consultations and contact routes without ratings or owner-gated publication bypass.
negative_controls: convert artifact presence into a regulator rating and require scope rejection
remove the owner gate and require publication policy failure
improvements: freeze the five factual artifact checks with UNCHECKABLE semantics
propose thirty regulators and retain the owner gate through human approval

specialists.mission: Design an interpretability instrument that tests whether published artifacts can be independently reproduced, not merely whether explanatory prose exists.
negative_controls: treat explanatory prose as reproduction and require evidence-class failure
ignore environment drift and require replay-manifest failure
improvements: define a reproduction manifest for code, data, environment and expected outputs
propose thirty interpretability artifacts with independent replay outcomes

specialists.mission: Audit scheduled claim re-reads for unchanged, disclosed-change, silent-change, withdrawn and unreachable states without judging whether the original claim is true.
negative_controls: label an unreachable claim withdrawn and require state-vocabulary failure
interpret a silent change as falsehood and require scope rejection
improvements: complete the gated re-read wave with at least thirty claims
publish claim-state transition fixtures and disclosure-review samples

specialists.mission: Audit the reviewed serving-fidelity method for model identity and reference parity while preserving the free-credit hold and UNMEASURED state.
negative_controls: run paid inference without approval and require the spend gate to refuse
treat a reviewed method as a completed run and require status failure
improvements: complete free-credit reference replay with immutable request manifests
replace the short method reference with a full content digest before any measurement run

specialists.mission: Audit the daily public watchdog and incident intake: that each pinned source was probed on schedule, that each answer carried the shape its publisher documents, and that no unreachable or unparseable source is ever reported as a count of zero.
audit_focus: REACHABLE vs UNREACHABLE vs UNCHECKABLE separation
daily run freshness and published index agreement
unpinned findings stay visible as gaps
negative_controls: point a pinned source at a dead host and require the row to read UNREACHABLE, never 0
serve HTML where a feed is documented and require UNCHECKABLE, never a zero count
improvements: freeze the daily run window and sha-pin it so the axis can carry a real n instead of staying a declared slot
open a data request with the AI Incident Database maintainers for a public incident export path, since the site serves HTML only
